consumer: The frontend paperdoll renderer, asking 'which item fills the wielded slot and which item fills each worn body-part slot' for display.
scope: Only the wielded slot and the worn-slot set as the GUI would lay them out on the body silhouette; NOT loose carried inventory.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps wielded_items() + worn + the entire inv_const_slice() as one flat carried_items[] array tagged wielded|worn|inventory.
divergence: A flashlight stowed inside a worn backpack: it is emitted with location 'inventory' and a paperdoll consumer reading carried_items[] has no slot mapping, so backpack contents (or the full inventory) pollute the worn/wielded slot view the paperdoll must render.
